high_level_description: The image is a split-screen display featuring two different interpretations of the iconic Lady Dior handbag by Dior. On the left side: The handbag has a light green handle and a white body. The front of the bag is adorned with a vibrant floral pattern, predominantly pink flowers with green leaves. The design includes intricate details such as gold embellishments and a small golden clasp at the top. On the right side: The handbag has a red handle and a multicolored body with a geometric and abstract design. The colors on the bag include shades of red, yellow, green, and black
